Geometry.Desc: Contains the geometry description of the aircraft

SurfaceRefPoint.Desc: Position of the reference point to global point of reference

SectionPoints.Desc: number of points of profile. Will be used by spline interpolation if DoInterpolate attribute is set true

SurfaceSegments.Desc: Number of segments in this pylon

InnerProfile_Segment.Desc: Inner airfoil segment. Geometry is stored in seperate file (*.dat)

OuterProfile_Segment.Desc: Outer airfoil segment. Geometry is stored in seperate file (*.dat)

l_i_Segment.Desc: Chord length of segments inner profile

l_o_Segment.Desc: Chord length of segments outer profile

epsilon_Segment.Desc: Angle of twist of surface segment

nu_Segment.Desc: Angle of dihedral of surface segment

phi_Segment.Desc: Angle of sweep of surface segment
